declaration.dataset_role: CB6-T h8_tail: SCREEN (Stage 1) and HOLDOUT (Stage 2, sealed) event-hash split; exploratory_historical, not prospective, not an edge claim
declaration.read_rules: verify the listing hash first; append every read to ACCESS_LOG.jsonl; the runner refuses HOLDOUT until Stage 1 of CB6-T is final and committed; outcomes only from outcomes_guarded.csv.gz; DROPPED_* blocks are never read
declaration.topup_frame_disclosure: the h8_tail_b frame reflects Gamma market state after T_fetch8 (status, edited end dates), because it was listed after h8_tail; it is limited by outcome censoring (end_at <= T_fetch8 - 7 d) and the price/print cap min(T_fetch8, T_seal); h8_tail's frame reflects state at T_fetch8

read_location.note: one read location for the life of h8; a change needs a committed note and the access log carried across

split.rule: sha256(SPLIT_SEED + '|' + event_key), first byte even -> SCREEN else HOLDOUT; event_key = Gamma event id (market id if none), merged across negRiskMarketID (component minimum)
